takeaway: The radar's sixth scored forecast got 11 of its top 15 right (73%), the best yet. Agent memory is picking up: claude-mem's daily star gains rose from 315 to 1,612 over three days after three releases.

findings.heading: Best top-15 hit rate so far
findings.text: The Oct 24 ranking got 73% of its top 15 right across 64 apps, against about 23% for random picks. Rank correlation held at 0.65: the top is right, the tail less so.

findings.heading: claude-mem accelerates after three releases
findings.text: Measured gains of 315, 949 and then 1,612 stars a day, to 106,674. Versions 15.5 to 15.7 shipped on Oct 29 and 30, adding a My Work view of agent sessions.

findings.heading: Jailbreak-prompt library stays #1
findings.text: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks gained 1,972 stars (9,549 to 11,521), a third day near 2,000.

findings.heading: Last week's leaders slow
findings.text: impeccable gained 1,492 stars (2,433 the day before), DeepTutor 1,220 (2,202) and hallmark 944 (1,203).

findings.heading: Big skill collections reach trending
findings.text: mattpocock/skills (307,670 stars) and anthropics/skills (185,514, +1,888 this week) appeared on trending for the first time on the radar.

caveats: Six matured forecasts are still a small sample; the tuner's bar keeps noise-sized gains from moving any setting.
Only one new company figure today, from August, and from a search-result summary.
Every re-observed repo page showed a rounded count.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
